title: Aye salami qayaam jalte hai
body:
Aye salami qayaam jalte hai
Ran me namoose sheh nikalte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ran me bajte hai fatha ke baaje
Dar se bewo ke dam nikalte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
baithi hai bibiya'n andhere me
Shaamiyo me chiraagh jalte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Zere qanjar hai gardane shabbir
Murtaza gham se haath malte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre asghar se kehti thi banu
aye lahad hum yaha'n se chalte hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu humaari tarah se behlaana
shab ko asghar bohot machalte hai
